Extract metadata from Input-Output components

get_io_metadata.Rd

For each component (sector, intermediate_consumption, final_demand, added_value, labour, land_proportion, landuse_table, growth_rate), this function returns a tidy tibble with descriptive metadata: - class, dimensions, missing values, min/max, names, hardcoded descriptions, and user‑provided units.

Usage

get_io_metadata(
  sector,
  intermediate_consumption,
  final_demand,
  added_value,
  labour,
  land_proportion,
  landuse_table,
  growth_rate,
  sector_units = NA_character_,
  ic_units = NA_character_,
  fd_units = NA_character_,
  av_units = NA_character_,
  labour_units = NA_character_,
  lp_units = NA_character_,
  lu_units = NA_character_,
  gr_units = NA_character_
)

Arguments

sector

A data frame/tibble with sector names in first column.

intermediate_consumption

Numeric matrix.

final_demand

Numeric matrix.

added_value

Numeric matrix.

labour

Vector, 1-column matrix, or 1-column data frame.

land_proportion

Numeric matrix.

landuse_table

Data frame/tibble with "LC" and "area".

growth_rate

Numeric vector.

sector_units

Character string for sector units (default NA).

ic_units

Character string for intermediate consumption units (default NA).

fd_units

Character string for final demand units (default NA).

av_units

Character string for added value units (default NA).

labour_units

Character string for labour units (default NA).

lp_units

Character string for land proportion units (default NA).

lu_units

Character string for landuse table units (default NA).

gr_units

Character string for growth rate units (default NA).

Value

A list with two elements:

metadata

A tibble with one row per component and columns for key attributes including Description and Units.

details

A list containing more detailed metadata for each component (e.g., names, per‑column summaries).
